name: Methow River (Winthrop – Twisp)
blurb: Western-town float from Winthrop's Red Barn — tubers in late summer, quick spring water.

sections.notes: Late-summer float from Mack Lloyd Park/Red Barn to the Big Eddy/Rising Eagle roadside turnout. Big Eddy has a steep unimproved carry, no boat ramp, and can be difficult for larger boats; scout the actual landing and carry before setting a shuttle. Respect posted parking restrictions and private land. AW rates the full 50-mile guide reach II(III); that is not a certification of current conditions on this shorter float.
sections.routeReview: Approximate river-course overview only. The generalized historical line can cross exposed gravel bars; it does not map safe bridge passages or shoreline carries. Identify the usable landing and current hazards before launching.

sections.notes: Big Eddy/Rising Eagle is unimproved roadside access with a steep carry, not a boat ramp. Twisp Park has public river access but no established larger-watercraft put-in ramp in the Town plan. The confluence landing and steep carry can be difficult, especially at high water; scout the exit and suitability for your craft before launching. Area markers do not identify exact bank connections.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
